entities.name: Ezrim
entities.description: A guildless Archon from Ravnica, chief of the Ravnican Agency of Magicological Investigations.

entities.name: Ravnican Agency of Magicological Investigations
entities.description: Agency grown from Ezrim's truth cult after the invasion.

entities.name: Lavinia
entities.description: Azorius figure who assumed Ezrim would rejoin the Senate.

entities.name: Etrata
entities.description: Dimir assassin arrested as a suspect.

entities.name: Kaya Cassir
entities.description: Enlisted by Ezrim to lead the investigation; recaptured Anzrag and defeated Oba.

entities.name: Anzrag
entities.description: Gruul mole god who escaped containment.

entities.name: Alquist Proft
entities.description: Detective who invited Ezrim to Vitu-Ghazi and revealed the truth.

entities.name: Vitu-Ghazi
entities.description: Place where the truth of the murders was revealed.

entities.name: Oba
entities.description: Central dryad of Trostani, who organized the murders; captured Ezrim and was defeated.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion after which Ezrim's cult became the Agency.

events.summary: After the invasion Ezrim's truth cult becomes the Ravnican Agency of Magicological Investigations.
events.quote: becoming the Ravnican Agency of Magicological Investigations

events.summary: Ezrim is present at Karlov Manor when Zegana is assassinated and assists the investigation.
events.quote: he was present at Karlov Manor when Zegana was assassinated

events.summary: Ezrim enlists Kaya Cassir to lead the investigation after Etrata's arrest.
events.quote: enlisted Kaya Cassir to lead the investigation

events.summary: Ezrim challenges the escaped Anzrag before Kaya recaptures it.
events.quote: Ezrim challenged the god before it was recaptured by Kaya

events.summary: At Vitu-Ghazi, Proft reveals Oba organized the murders; Oba captures Ezrim, who is freed when Kaya and Etrata defeat her.
events.quote: Ezrim was captured, but was freed after Oba was defeated by Kaya and Etrata

relations.quote: He is the chief of the Ravnican Agency of Magicological Investigations.
